mode.title: Mode
mode.description: "run-task" executes an agent task and returns a signed receipt. "verify-receipt" checks a receipt you already have (free).

task.title: Task
task.description: The task prompt for the agent to complete. Required when mode is "run-task".

llmProvider.title: LLM provider
llmProvider.description: Which model provider to call. Required when mode is "run-task".

llmApiKey.title: LLM API key
llmApiKey.description: Your own API key for the selected provider (bring-your-own-key). Never stored or logged. Required when mode is "run-task".

model.title: Model (optional)
model.description: Override the default model for the selected provider. Groq defaults to openai/gpt-oss-120b. Retired Groq ids (qwen/qwen3-32b, llama-3.3-70b-versatile) are remapped.

toolAllowlist.title: Tool allowlist (optional)
toolAllowlist.description: Restrict which built-in tools the agent may use. Omit to allow all built-in tools; pass an empty list to disable tools entirely.

maxSteps.title: Max steps (optional)
maxSteps.description: Maximum model/tool-call round trips before the run stops itself. Default 10.

receipt.title: Receipt to verify
receipt.description: A receipt object previously returned by a "run-task" run. Required when mode is "verify-receipt".
